# Contract: image-gen

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: design. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Provider-backed images, variations, reference consistency and cut-outs, with reproducible non-secret settings, behind an explicit spend gate.

## Use it for
- "generate an illustration"
- "make a transparent cut-out"

## Not for
- a chart or anything with exact text (set it in code)
- a fake screenshot or document (refused)

## Accepted inputs
A prompt, optional reference images.

## Deliverables
Images, contact sheet, sidecar JSON without keys.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+

Optional:
- GEMINI_API_KEY (user's own)
- OPENAI_API_KEY (user's own)

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Sends the prompt and any reference images to the chosen provider, only after --approve-spend.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Paid per image; price unknown to the script; plan shown first.

## Workflow
1. See SKILL.md (the method is written as prose sections).

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Approve provider, model, call count and cost before any call

## Quality checks
- Dry-run plan
- contact sheet reviewed

## Common failures
- No key (clear message)
- Model names change (checked at run time)

## Limitations
- Quotas, prices and output rights are the provider's
